text: Two tickets. Dinner before the film. That should be easy. With As I Am, I ask for bigger buttons and two seats together.
The tiny seat map becomes clear pairs. I can compare the original view without losing my choice.
The agent can help. I still choose my seats and confirm them myself.
Next, dinner. The restaurant gets my preferences, not my booking details or personal reasons. Different design. No need to explain everything again.
This guided demo runs preset requests. With native Web M C P, an agent can discover supported changes, apply preferences, and check the rendered result. Only the functional receipt travels.

chapter: The web adapts. You don’t have to.
